question: Can an outside birth spend the last actual loose name still required for a marked clock turn under raw growth?
public_inputs: The approved design and prior true-role ground truth, the physical clock source and previously demonstrated pure positive history.
forbidden_inputs: Scorer identities do not grant permission, substitute for physical parentage or certify uniqueness.
primary_observable: Same physical source and fork, same one remaining eligible input, proof all complete target realizations still require its future use, and a fully replayed positive turn.
cheapest_meaningful_control: At the fork take the exact required child on the same loose slot and actually complete the clock.
resource_budget: Begin with funded 20-event route and one preparatory write, expand as registered, record bounds and censoring, register longer than ten minutes beforehand.
first_executable_signal: Validate the previously funded 20-event route and test each pending true role for an actual co-admitted outside competitor.
stop_rule: Matched irreversible true last-slot loss, or proved nonvacuous first-spend restriction on the registered fully paid source.
decision_or_followup_rule: A bounded failure to find a fork does not prove its absence. Validate an attained fork in both laws, inspect stronger priority and control arms, and preserve distinctions between last-slot exhaustion and prior-common-child exclusion.
